metadata.source: ours: the fork has no Mystery Gift program. Starts on the overworld or the main menu of a save past autostory's last checkpoint (03.15-mable-reward), where Mystery Gift opens

checkpoint.title: Claim the catalog's Mystery Gifts, box them and save

events.why: today's date and the catalog printed; X opens the main menu, whose party cards must show five or six Pokémon at full HP
the Boxes paged with L to the box titled Box 1 and left there, so a gift received into a full party lands in it; a gift an earlier run left in party slot 6 moved to its Box 1 slot and read there
each gift not past its last day, by code or from the Internet list; one not received fails and the next is tried

the Boxes on Box 1 again, read by its title; the gift received into party slot 6 moved to its Box 1 slot; each Pokémon gift received now must read in its slot, which read empty before the claims, else the run stops before the save
R, Save Progress, checked by its Last Saved time, when any gift was received or a Pokémon moved
one line a gift; the run fails naming any gift that failed
